units.source_text: 朝代更换后，源氏公子对万事但觉意兴阑珊。

en.t: After the reign changed, Prince Genji found that everything had lost its charm for him.

units.source_text: 又因升任大将，身份更加尊贵，未便轻举妄动，幽会私通之事，不得不稍稍敛迹。

en.t: Moreover, since he had been promoted to general and his rank had become still more exalted, he could no longer act rashly, and had to restrain himself somewhat in matters of secret meetings and affairs.

units.source_text: 因此各处情人，都等得心焦，怨恨悲叹。

en.t: As a result, his lovers in various places grew anxious from waiting, and lamented with resentment and sorrow.

units.source_text: 多管是报应吧，他自己恋慕那个冷酷的藤壶皇后，也有无穷的悲伤怨恨。

en.t: Perhaps it was retribution, for he himself longed for the cold-hearted Empress Fujitsubo and suffered endless grief and resentment.
